title: Disjunctive and Stressed Pronouns
author: ERgzLEN9pchn62XKb
chapter_outcomes: Use personal pronouns correctly in all persons, singular and plural
Use object pronouns: direct and indirect including position, order, agreement
Use demonstrative pronouns (e.g. ça, cela, celui, celle, -ci, -là, celui/celle de, celui/celle qui, celui/celle que, celui/celle dont)
Use interrogative pronouns (e.g. qui ? que ? qui est-ce que/qui ? lequel ?)
Use relative pronouns (e.g. qui, que, dont, où, quoi, ce qui, ce que, lequel/laquelle)
Use indefinite pronouns (e.g. quelque chose, quelqu'un, chacun, certain, n'importe qui, n'importe quoi)
